# 101 — Application_Starting

Indicates that application initialization is beginning\.

[All events](index.md) · [Application category](Category_Application.md) · [API reference](xref:Patware.Diagnostics.ApplicationEvents.ApplicationEvents.Starting)

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| EventId | 101 |
| Name | Application_Starting |
| Category | [Application](Category_Application.md) |
| Event class | LowLevel |
| Log level | Information |
| Status | Stable |
| Introduced | 0.0.1 |

## Usage

Import `Patware.Diagnostics.ApplicationEvents`. This example assumes an existing
`ILogger` named `logger` and caller-supplied variables for the arguments.

```csharp
logger.Application.Starting();
```

**Trigger:** Emit immediately before beginning application initialization\.

**Message template:** Application is starting\.

## Arguments

None.

## Remarks

- Framework or bootstrap logging may occur before this event; it does not guarantee that it is the first log record in the process\.
- Command\-line arguments are excluded because they may contain sensitive information\.
